description: Merchant check (KYB facts) before an agent pays: give a merchant's domain and optionally its company name, get neutral sourced facts in one call for merchant verification and vendor due diligence: domain registration date and age, expiry and registrar (registry RDAP), DNS and SPF/DMARC email-auth, an OFAC sanctions screen of the name, GLEIF LEI match and SEC EDGAR match. No risk score or fraud verdict. Signed receipt. Price: $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"domain":"apple.com","name":"Apple Inc."}.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country filter for LEI matches

lei.description: Optional 20-character LEI (instead of a GLEIF name search)

name.description: Company legal or trading name; screens OFAC (entities only), GLEIF LEI and SEC

ticker.description: Optional US stock ticker for the SEC match

name: merchant_check

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Sourced facts[] plus domain, sanctions (OFAC), lei and sec sections for a merchant; no score or verdict

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Merchant Check (KYB facts)
